evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-14", a date only with no time. POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 {"dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 200 and the due date changed. PATCH {"clearDueDate":true} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed. PATCH {"dueDate":null} did not remove it, but the clearDueDate flag works.
evidence.AC3: On POST, dueDate "2026-02-30", "15.10.2026" and "garbage" each returned 400. PATCH with dueDate "2026-02-30" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Test data, with today = 2026-10-15: past (due 10-14), today (due 10-15), future (due 10-16), none (no due date), and pastdone (due 2026-01-01, then marked done). GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the 'past' todo. Not overdue: due today, due in the future, no due date, and done.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed 2026-10-14, 2026-10-15, 2026-10-16 and 2026-01-01 next to the todos that have a due date. The todo without a due date showed none.
evidence.AC6: On the list page only the 'past' todo showed the word "überfällig". The today, future, no-date and done todos did not.
evidence.AC7: The list page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only the 'past' todo with its overdue marker.
